responsibility: This definition module declares procedures for parsing command-line arguments out of a single character-array command string rather than the process argv vector. It belongs to the gm2 string/argument utility layer and exports GetArg and Narg as the stable ARRAY OF CHAR interface for tokenizing quoted and unquoted arguments from text.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the CmdArgs pair: it declares the ARRAY OF CHAR command-string parsing interface, while CmdArgs.mod implements the tokenizer for quoted, escaped, and whitespace-separated arguments.
